method: Whisper small without expected-text prompting, VAD disabled, full clip and overlapping crops

segments.text: 我点的不是外卖 是你

assessment.short_line: Both the full clip without VAD and the 6–9 second crop transcribe 妈; the previous VAD-enabled omission is not evidence that the line is absent.
assessment.limitations: Other crops produce inconsistent text, including a likely transcription hallucination. These results do not verify speaker identity, lip sync or visual quality.
